lines.zh: 方圆之内别无他人，唯余你与这具空心傀儡独处。
lines.en: No other living soul stirs nearby—only you and this hollow simulacrum.

lines.zh: 四下无人之际，死灵之书的低语往往最为清晰。你听见了么？
lines.en: When none are near, the whispers of the Necronomicon ring clearest. Do you hear them?

lines.zh: 孤独并非安全，凡人。没有旁人的目光，不代表没有深渊的眼睛在注视着你。
lines.en: Solitude is not safety, mortal. The absence of mortal eyes does not mean the Abyss has looked away.

lines.zh: 你独自立于天地之间，恰如被群星遗忘在虚空角落的微尘。
lines.en: You stand alone between earth and sky, like a mote forgotten by the stars in a corner of the Void.

lines.zh: 寂静包裹着你，然而这片寂静之中，却藏着比喧嚣更沉重的压迫。
lines.en: Silence wraps around you—yet within this hush hides a weight heavier than any clamor.

lines.zh: 没有同伴，没有猎物，唯有你自己的呼吸在耳畔回响。
lines.en: No companion, no quarry—only your own breath echoing in your ears.

lines.zh: 独行者最容易在漫长的沉默里迷失理智的边界。
lines.en: Those who walk alone are quickest to lose the borders of sanity in the long quiet.

lines.zh: 四周空无一物，正好让我毫无干扰地审视你这具脆弱的容器。
lines.en: With nothing else around, I may examine your frail vessel without distraction.

lines.zh: 附近有生灵的气息在流动。无论它们是猎手还是猎物，终究都逃不过时间的吞噬。
lines.en: Living presences stir nearby. Whether hunter or prey, none escape the maw of time.

lines.zh: 这片土地上尚有喘息之物在活动，证明疯狂的潮水还未彻底漫过此地。
lines.en: Things still draw breath around you—proof that the tide of madness has not yet drowned this place.

lines.zh: 无数微不足道的生命在周围穿梭，各自奔忙于毫无意义的挣扎之中。
lines.en: Trivial lives scurry nearby, each lost in its own meaningless struggle.

lines.zh: 有某种存在正与你同处这片空间。保持警惕吧，傀儡。
lines.en: Something shares this space with you. Keep watch, puppet.

lines.zh: 凡俗的生灵来去匆匆，唯有深渊的凝视永恒不移。
lines.en: Mortal creatures come and go like mist; only the Abyssal gaze never shifts.

lines.zh: 这片寂静之中，唯有那唯一的一个身影与你遥遥相对。
lines.en: Within this stillness, only a single figure stands opposite you.

lines.zh: 方圆之内仅存那{count}道孤零零的气息——恰如被世界遗弃的最后一个见证者。
lines.en: Only {count} lone presence lingers nearby—like the last witness abandoned by the world.

lines.zh: 仅有{count}个目标在你的视野边缘游荡。是交锋，还是任其自生自灭？
lines.en: Just {count} solitary form drifts at the rim of your sight. Will you strike, or leave it to its fate?

lines.zh: 唯一的存在往往比成群的乌合之众更值得留意。
lines.en: A solitary presence often merits closer watch than a mindless herd.

lines.zh: 只有寥寥几个身影在附近徘徊，倒也算不上什么大阵仗。
lines.en: Only a handful of figures linger nearby—scarcely a host worth naming.

lines.zh: 你周遭的{count}道气息若隐若现，像是在试探，又像是在观望。
lines.en: Those {count} presences flicker around you, half probing, half watching.

lines.zh: 数目虽少，却也足够在暗处织成一张致命的网。切莫掉以轻心。
lines.en: Few in number, yet enough to weave a lethal snare in the dark. Do not drop your guard.

lines.zh: 仅此{count}个生灵在侧，尚不足以填满深渊的胃口。
lines.en: Merely {count} creatures at hand—scarcely enough to whet the appetite of the Abyss.

lines.zh: 成群的生灵在四周骚动，喧嚣声几乎要盖过深渊的低语。
lines.en: Crowds of creatures stir all around you, their clamor nearly drowning out the whispers of the Abyss.

lines.zh: 整整{count}个身影在你的感知边缘攒动——好一幅群魔乱舞的景象。
lines.en: Full {count} figures swarm at the edge of your senses—quite the revel of lesser things.

lines.zh: 如此众多的血肉聚集在此，简直像是一场专门为外神筹备的盛大祭典。
lines.en: So much flesh gathered in one place looks almost like a grand sacrifice prepared for the Outer Gods.

lines.zh: 四周足有{count}道气息交织在一起，混乱而嘈杂，令人联想起疯狂爆发前的征兆。
lines.en: No fewer than {count} presences tangle together around you—chaotic and loud, like an omen before madness breaks.

lines.zh: 另一位凡人{player}就在附近。在彼此猜忌与贪婪的驱使下，你们人类总是互相提防。
lines.en: Another mortal, {player}, is nearby. Driven by suspicion and greed, you humans forever watch one another askance.

lines.zh: 不知{player}在看见你如今这副模样时，心底究竟是敬畏，还是抑制不住的恐惧？
lines.en: When {player} beholds the form you wear, what stirs within—awe, or barely stifled terror?

lines.zh: 这世上又多了一个窥探禁忌的灵魂——{player}距离疯狂还剩几步之遥？
lines.en: Another soul prowls near the forbidden—how many steps remain before {player} slips into madness?

lines.zh: 你可以与{player}结伴同行，也可以在某个黑夜里将秘密永远留在自己的喉咙里。
lines.en: You may walk beside {player}, or keep your secrets locked in your throat when night falls.

lines.zh: 在旧日支配者眼中，你与{player}并无区别，皆是在棋盘上挣扎的微小棋子。
lines.en: To a Great Old One, you and {player} are alike—tiny pawns scraping across the board.

lines.zh: 莫要向{player}轻易泄露死灵之书的真意，凡人的心智往往经不起真相的重量。
lines.en: Do not lightly reveal the Necronomicon's true meaning to {player}; mortal minds rarely bear the weight of truth.

lines.zh: 一个普通的{entity}正在附近忙碌，对宇宙之外那令人发狂的真相一无所知。
lines.en: An ordinary {entity} bustles nearby, blissfully blind to the maddening truth beyond the cosmos.

lines.zh: 看看这些{entity}吧——他们用几颗绿宝石换取安稳的幻觉，仿佛世界永远不会崩塌。
lines.en: Look at these {entity}—trading emeralds for the illusion of comfort, as though the world could never collapse.

lines.zh: 在{entity}平庸的日常生活之下，深渊的阴影正在地底一寸寸地蔓延。
lines.en: Beneath the mundane days of {entity}, the shadow of the Abyss creeps onward inch by inch underground.

lines.zh: 莫要惊扰这群无知的{entity}，或者……你也可以亲手撕开他们那脆弱的安宁。
lines.en: Do not startle these ignorant {entity}—or, if you will, tear open their fragile peace yourself.

lines.zh: 一具腐烂的{entity}正蹒跚逼近，嘴里发出含混不清的嘶哑低吼。
lines.en: A rotting {entity} shambles nearer, guttural groans scraping from its throat.

lines.zh: 这具{entity}毫无神智可言，仅仅被对活人血肉的本能渴望所驱使。
lines.en: This {entity} holds not a spark of mind, driven solely by brute craving for living flesh.

lines.zh: 连死去多年的{entity}都知道渴望生机，可见凡人对死亡的恐惧是何等根深蒂固。
lines.en: Even a long-dead {entity} still reaches for the living—so deep-rooted is mortal terror of death.

lines.zh: 在深渊荒地，连僵尸都会被珊瑚彻底异化。眼前的这只{entity}，倒还算得上“温和”。
lines.en: In the Abyssal Wasteland, even zombies are warped by Coralium; this {entity} before you seems mild by comparison.

lines.zh: 一具苍白的{entity}正在黑暗中嘎吱作响，空洞的眼眶里跳动着执拗的冷火。
lines.en: A pale {entity} clatters in the dark, stubborn cold fire flickering in its hollow sockets.

lines.zh: 失去了血肉的束缚后，这具{entity}反而成了更为纯粹的杀戮工具。
lines.en: Freed from the burden of flesh, this {entity} has become a cleaner instrument of slaughter.

lines.zh: {entity}拉紧弓弦的声响在夜色中格外刺耳，仿佛死神正在校准准星。
lines.en: The creak of {entity} drawing its bowstring cuts sharply through the dark, like Death taking aim.

lines.zh: 即便化作一堆枯骨，{entity}依然被某种不死诅咒强行拖在尘世之间。
lines.en: Reduced to dry bone, {entity} is still dragged across the earth by some undying curse.

lines.zh: 一只{entity}正悄无声息地靠近——那绿色皮囊里塞满了随时准备撕碎血肉的火药。
lines.en: A {entity} creeps silently nearer—its green hide packed with powder eager to rend flesh.

lines.zh: 小心背后那只{entity}。无声的接近与瞬间的爆裂，正是它唯一懂得的语言。
lines.en: Mind the {entity} at your back. Silent approach and sudden ruin are the only tongue it speaks.

lines.zh: 连那{entity}也敢把嘶嘶声指向披着扎哈尔形貌的你？真是毫无敬畏的蠢物。
lines.en: Even a {entity} dares aim its hiss at one wearing J'zahar's likeness? What a reverenceless thing.

lines.zh: 在{entity}引爆自己之前解决它，否则这具傀儡的衣袍可就要染上焦黑的灰烬了。
lines.en: End that {entity} before it bursts, lest this simulacrum's robes be blackened with ash.

lines.zh: 一只多足的{entity}正潜伏在暗处，复眼里闪烁着冰冷而饥饿的红光。
lines.en: A many-legged {entity} lurks in the gloom, cold, hungry red glinting in its cluster of eyes.

lines.zh: {entity}在黑暗中编织着无形的罗网，耐心等待着鲁莽的猎物一头撞入。
lines.en: {entity} spins unseen snares in the dark, waiting patiently for rash prey to blunder in.

lines.zh: 那令人毛骨悚然的节肢摩擦声，预示着{entity}随时可能从头顶或岩壁猛扑而下。
lines.en: The chilling scrape of chitin warns that {entity} may drop from overhead or the rock face at any moment.

lines.zh: 毒牙与蛛丝是{entity}赖以生存的伎俩——在真正的深渊生物面前，这不过是虫豸的把戏。
lines.en: Venomous fangs and silk are the tricks of {entity}—mere vermin's play beside true Abyssal horrors.

lines.zh: 那个修长的黑影{entity}正站在不远处，警惕地守望着虚空的秘密。
lines.en: That tall, dark figure—{entity}—stands not far off, jealously guarding the secrets of the void.

lines.zh: {entity}厌恶被凡人直视双眸，仿佛它那双紫瞳里藏着什么不容亵渎的真理。
lines.en: {entity} despises being looked in the eye by mortals, as though its violet gaze hid some sacred truth.

lines.zh: 看着它吧——连末地来的{entity}也懂得在深渊的目光下保持颤栗与敬畏。
lines.en: Look upon it—even {entity} of the End knows to shudder beneath the gaze of the Abyss.

lines.zh: 随手搬运泥土与石块的{entity}，究竟是在筑造什么，还是仅仅在盲目模仿早已失落的文明？
lines.en: What does {entity} build as it carries earth and stone—or does it merely mimic a vanished civilization blind?

lines.zh: 一旦激怒了{entity}，它便会撕裂空间瞬息而至。切莫在毫无防备时盯住它的脸。
lines.en: Provoke {entity} and it will tear through space in a blink. Do not lock eyes with it unprepared.

lines.zh: 一个疯癫的{entity}正在附近低笑，手中攥着散发出刺鼻气味的诡异药瓶。
lines.en: A crazed {entity} cackles nearby, clutching foul-smelling phials of strange brews.

lines.zh: {entity}自以为掌握了禁忌的魔药与诅咒，殊不知她在深渊眼中不过是个摆弄泥浆的学徒。
lines.en: {entity} fancies herself mistress of forbidden brews and hexes, blind to being a mere mud-dabbler before the Abyss.

lines.zh: 小心{entity}投掷的毒剂！那些炼金残渣足以让大意的凡人痛苦哀嚎。
lines.en: Beware the toxins hurled by {entity}! Those alchemical dregs can bring a careless mortal to agony.

lines.zh: 即便没有研读过死灵之书，{entity}也早已在孤独与偏执中滑向了疯狂的边缘。
lines.en: Without ever opening the Necronomicon, {entity} has already slid toward madness through solitude and spite.

lines.zh: 一团半透明的{entity}正在地面上弹跳蠕动，毫无章法可言。
lines.en: A translucent {entity} bounces and squelches across the ground without rhyme or reason.

lines.zh: 这低等的{entity}没有骨骼，亦没有大脑——简直像是沙格斯最可怜、最微不足道的拙劣模仿品。
lines.en: This lowly {entity} has neither bone nor brain—like the saddest, faintest caricature of a Shoggoth.

lines.zh: 黏腻的{entity}在泥土间留下湿滑的痕迹，既恶心，又显得荒诞可笑。
lines.en: Slimy {entity} leaves slick trails across the dirt—both repulsive and absurd.

lines.zh: 将它劈碎之后，更大的{entity}只会分裂成更多烦人的小块。
lines.en: Cleave it apart, and a larger {entity} merely splits into more tiresome pieces.

lines.zh: 一头卑微的{animal}正在附近徘徊，对头顶那片即将倾覆的星海一无所知。
lines.en: A lowly {animal} wanders nearby, blissfully ignorant of the star-sea poised to capsize overhead.

lines.zh: 这只{animal}只懂得觅食与苟活——有时，无知反而是凡俗生灵最大的仁慈。
lines.en: This {animal} knows only grazing and survival—at times, ignorance is the greatest mercy granted to mortal beasts.

lines.zh: 看着那只{animal}吧。在旧日支配者眼中，它与所谓智慧的凡人并无本质差异。
lines.en: Look upon that {animal}. To a Great Old One, it differs scarcely at all from supposedly wise mortals.

lines.zh: 血肉之躯皆是脆弱的过客。今日的{animal}，明日便可能沦为珊瑚或恐惧的祭品。
lines.en: All flesh is a fragile passerby. Today's {animal} may become tomorrow's offering to Coralium or Dread.

lines.zh: 一头警觉的{entity}在附近游走，那双野性的兽瞳正打量着你的每一个动作。
lines.en: A wary {entity} pads nearby, its feral eyes measuring your every move.

lines.zh: {entity}懂得群体的法则与狩猎的耐心——莫要轻易激怒这头拥有利齿的野兽。
lines.en: {entity} knows the law of the pack and the patience of the hunt—do not lightly provoke its fangs.

lines.zh: 看那{entity}的反应吧：究竟是将你视作可驯服的主人，还是嗅出了你体内非人的气息？
lines.en: Watch how {entity} reacts: does it see a master to follow, or scent something inhuman within you?

lines.zh: {entity}的嚎叫曾在无数个黑夜里令凡人战栗，然而在真正的外神面前，它也不过是条温顺的犬。
lines.en: The howl of {entity} has chilled mortals on countless nights; yet before the Outer Gods, it is a meek hound.

lines.zh: 一尊沉默的{entity}矗立在附近，以泥土或金铁之躯执行着主人留下的死命令。
lines.en: A silent {entity} stands nearby, carrying out dead orders within a frame of clay or iron.

lines.zh: 没有灵魂、没有恐惧、亦没有理智——某种意义上，{entity}比凡人更接近傀儡的完美形态。
lines.en: No soul, no fear, no reason—in a sense, {entity} is closer to the pure form of a puppet than any mortal.

lines.zh: 看着那尊{entity}吧。凡人总以为自己能掌控亲手捏造的造物，直到造物失控的那一日。
lines.en: Behold that {entity}. Mortals always trust they control what their hands have shaped—until the day it turns.

lines.zh: {entity}沉重的脚步震动着地面，忠实地守卫着这片毫无意义的尘土。
lines.en: The heavy tread of {entity} shakes the earth as it guards this meaningless dust.

lines.zh: 暗处正有充满敌意的{hostile}向你逼近！收起你的松懈，凡人。
lines.en: A hostile {hostile} closes in from the dark! Cast aside your slackness, mortal.

lines.zh: 那头{hostile}眼中闪烁着纯粹的杀意。在这残酷的诸界里，仁慈只会招致死亡。
lines.en: Pure malice gleams in the eyes of {hostile}. Across these cruel realms, mercy buys only death.

lines.zh: 阴影中的{hostile}已将你锁定为猎物——让它见识一下奥穆索守门人的怒火吧。
lines.en: {hostile} in the shadows has marked you as prey—show it the wrath of the Gatekeeper of Omothol.

lines.zh: 小心应对眼前的{hostile}。哪怕是微小的疏忽，也足以让鲜血染红你的脚下。
lines.en: Meet that {hostile} with care. Even a slight lapse is enough to stain the ground beneath you red.

lines.zh: 杀戮与被杀戮，本就是{hostile}与凡人之间唯一通行的法则。
lines.en: To slay or be slain is the only law recognized between {hostile} and mortal.

lines.zh: 利爪与獠牙正在逼近。握紧你的兵器，准备迎战{hostile}！
lines.en: Claw and fang draw near. Grip your weapon and face {hostile}!

lines.zh: 一具拒绝安息的{entity}正在附近徘徊，散发着腐尸与坟墓的恶臭。
lines.en: A {entity} that refuses rest shambles nearby, exhaling the stench of corpse and grave.

lines.zh: 死灵之书早已揭示：死亡并非终点，有时它只是另一场更为丑陋的奴役的开始。
lines.en: The Necronomicon has long shown that death is no end—at times it is only the start of a uglier servitude.

lines.zh: 这头{entity}被抽去了灵魂，只剩下一具听命于黑暗本能的残破躯壳。
lines.en: This {entity} has been emptied of soul, leaving only a broken shell obeying dark instinct.

lines.zh: 阳光或许能灼烧{entity}的腐肉，却烧不尽滋生不死诅咒的根源。
lines.en: Sunlight may sear the rot of {entity}, yet it cannot burn out the root of the undying curse.

lines.zh: 一股压倒性的威压正笼罩此地——{boss}就在你的面前！
lines.en: An overwhelming dread presses upon this place—{boss} stands before you!

lines.zh: 面对{boss}吧，凡人！让我看看这具空心傀儡究竟能承受几分真正的狂怒。
lines.en: Face {boss}, mortal! Let me see how much true fury this hollow simulacrum can endure.

lines.zh: {boss}的咆哮震颤着空气。若你的意志有半分动摇，下一瞬便会粉身碎骨。
lines.en: The roar of {boss} shakes the air. Should your will falter for a heartbeat, you will be shattered.

lines.zh: 能令{boss}现身于此，说明你已踏入了连死灵之书都要慎重警示的绝境。
lines.en: To stand before {boss} means you have entered a peril against which even the Necronomicon warns.

lines.zh: 莫要指望{boss}会向你俯首。在生死搏杀的熔炉里，唯有强者配得上继续前行。
lines.en: Do not expect {boss} to bow. In the crucible of lethal combat, only the strong earn the right to walk on.

lines.zh: 你周遭游荡着{entity}——深渊的造物已悄然渗入此界。
lines.en: {entity} prowls nearby—a creature of the Abyss already seeping into this realm.

lines.zh: 那头{entity}散发着熟悉的腐朽与疯狂气息，仿佛奥穆索的门扉就在它身后半掩。
lines.en: That {entity} reeks of familiar rot and madness, as though the Gate of Omothol stood ajar behind it.

lines.zh: 在{entity}的眼中，凡俗的秩序一文不值。莫要以为这具傀儡的皮囊能令它对你彻底驯服。
lines.en: In the eyes of {entity}, mortal order is worthless. Do not assume this simulacrum's likeness guarantees its obedience.

lines.zh: {entity}的低嘶在空气中回荡，宛如黑暗国度奏响的前奏。
lines.en: The hiss of {entity} ripples through the air like a prelude from the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: 一头被珊瑚瘟疫彻底吞噬的{entity}正在附近蠕动，浑身泛着病态的苍蓝。
lines.en: A {entity} wholly consumed by the Coralium Plague writhes nearby, glowing with a sickly azure.

lines.zh: 看看那{entity}吧——那就是触犯珊瑚禁忌后的最终下场。
lines.en: Behold that {entity}—such is the final end of meddling with the taboo of Coralium.

lines.zh: {entity}的血肉早已腐烂结晶，唯有疯狂的杀意仍在驱使着它的骸骨。
lines.en: The flesh of {entity} rotted and crystallized long ago; only mad malice still drives its bones.

lines.zh: 小心莫让{entity}的爪牙划破你的皮囊，珊瑚的毒素可不会讲半分情面。
lines.en: Take care the claws of {entity} do not tear your hide; Coralium venom knows no mercy.

lines.zh: 一头被恐惧瘟疫彻底扭曲的{entity}正在附近嘶吼，浑身渗出令人作呕的脓血。
lines.en: A {entity} warped beyond recognition by the Dread Plague howls nearby, oozing foul ichor.

lines.zh: 那就是{entity}——恐惧之地的原生噩梦，理性与形态被彻底碾碎后的产物。
lines.en: That is {entity}—a native nightmare of the Dreadlands, born when reason and form are crushed to pulp.

lines.zh: 千万莫让{entity}的毒爪触及你的躯体，恐惧瘟疫的蔓延可比珊瑚更加狂暴。
lines.en: Never let the tainted claws of {entity} graze your flesh; the Dread Plague spreads fiercer than Coralium.

lines.zh: 在{entity}扭曲的嚎叫声中，我仿佛又听见了查伽洛斯在巢穴深处的喘息。
lines.en: In the mangled shriek of {entity}, I hear once more the heavy breathing of Chagaroth in its lair.

lines.zh: 一团来自黑暗国度的{entity}正在阴影中蠕动，仿佛连光线都在恐惧它的存在。
lines.en: A {entity} of the Dark Realm writhes within the shade, as though light itself feared its presence.

lines.zh: 那{entity}没有血肉，没有骨骼，唯有纯粹的虚暗与无尽的憎恨。
lines.en: That {entity} has neither flesh nor bone—only pure shadow and unending hate.

lines.zh: 萨克索斯的眷族{entity}最喜爱在无光的角落里伏击大意的旅人。
lines.en: {entity}, kin of Sacthoth, delights in ambushing careless travelers from lightless corners.

lines.zh: 小心{entity}的触摸！黑暗生物的每一次打击都在削弱你与光明之间的联系。
lines.en: Beware the touch of {entity}! Every blow from a shadow creature frays your tie to the light.

lines.zh: Tekeli-li! 一头令人作呕的{entity}就在附近蠕动——那团不断沸腾增殖的原生质怪物！
lines.en: Tekeli-li! A loathsome {entity} churns nearby—that seething, ever-multiplying mass of protoplasm!

lines.zh: 连古老者都曾因{entity}的反叛而覆灭，区区凡人岂敢轻视这头不可名状的肉山？
lines.en: Even the Elder Things fell before the rebellion of {entity}; what mortal dares scorn this nameless mound of flesh?

lines.zh: {entity}的体表不断睁开又闭合着千万只眼睛，散发着令人疯狂的恶臭与尖啸。
lines.en: A thousand eyes open and shut across {entity}, exhaling a maddening stench and shrill piping.

lines.zh: 若不想被{entity}酸液般的躯体吞噬殆尽，便快些清理它周围滋生的巨石与粘液！
lines.en: If you do not wish to be dissolved inside {entity}, clear the monoliths and ooze breeding around it!

lines.zh: 看着{entity}那不断变换的畸形器官吧——这就是失去了理智与约束的混沌本身。
lines.en: Behold the shifting, grotesque organs of {entity}—that is Chaos itself, stripped of reason and restraint.

lines.zh: 一个源自奥穆索的{entity}正站在附近——它身上带着那座失落圣城特有的腐朽与尊严。
lines.en: A {entity} born of Omothol stands nearby, bearing the peculiar decay and dignity of that lost citadel.

lines.zh: 那名{entity}是禁忌知识的守护者，亦是群星之外最后的遗民。
lines.en: That {entity} is a keeper of forbidden lore—one of the last remnants beyond the stars.

lines.zh: 在{entity}面前，莫要显露出凡人的浅薄与无知，否则连阿克洛语的嘲讽你也听不懂。
lines.en: Before {entity}, do not parade mortal shallowness, lest you fail to grasp even its mockery in Aklo.

lines.zh: 连{entity}都在低声赞颂着外神的名字。你是否也能听懂那古老的音节？
lines.en: Even {entity} murmurs hymns to the Outer Gods. Can you decipher those ancient syllables?

lines.zh: 一头散发着硫磺与暴虐气息的{entity}正在附近徘徊。
lines.en: A {entity} reeking of sulfur and fury prowls nearby.

lines.zh: 凡人称{entity}为恶魔，却不知在真正的外神面前，地狱的爪牙也不过是暴躁的看门犬。
lines.en: Mortals call {entity} a demon, unaware that before the Outer Gods, the fiends of hell are mere ill-tempered hounds.

lines.zh: 那{entity}眼中燃烧着贪婪与毁灭欲，然而它的火焰照不亮奥穆索的半寸阴影。
lines.en: Greed and ruin burn in the eyes of {entity}, yet its flames cannot light a single span of Omothol's shadow.

lines.zh: 莫要轻视{entity}的利爪，下界的狂暴依然足以撕裂大意的凡胎。
lines.en: Do not scorn the claws of {entity}; Nether-born fury still suffices to shred a careless mortal.

lines.zh: 反物质的存在本身便是对现实法则的亵渎——稍有触碰，便会引发湮灭的狂潮。
lines.en: Antimatter is an affront to the laws of reality itself—one touch unleashes a tide of annihilation.

lines.zh: 那团{entity}在视野中扭曲着光线，仿佛宇宙在自我撕裂时留下的伤疤。
lines.en: That {entity} warps the light around it, like a scar left where the cosmos tore itself open.

lines.zh: 远离{entity}，凡人！湮灭从不区分敌我，亦不在乎你是否披着扎哈尔的形貌。
lines.en: Keep clear of {entity}, mortal! Annihilation spares neither friend nor foe, nor cares that you wear J'zahar's form.

lines.zh: {entity}散发着令人牙酸的虚无气息，宛如阿撒托斯梦呓中泄出的一粒火星。
lines.en: {entity} exhales a teeth-gritting emptiness, like a stray spark from the dreams of Azathoth.

lines.zh: 巨龙{entity}振翼掠过虚空，傲慢地俯视着脚下的一切凡物。
lines.en: The dragon {entity} beats its wings across the void, looking down in pride upon all earthly things.

lines.zh: 这头{entity}自诩为末地的主宰，然而在旧日支配者的漫长纪元里，龙族也不过是新近诞生的幼雏。
lines.en: This {entity} styles itself sovereign of the End; yet beside the aeons of the Great Old Ones, dragons are mere hatchlings.

lines.zh: 看着{entity}吐出的龙息吧——紫色的吐息虽烈，却远不及黑暗领域的一缕寒风致命。
lines.en: Watch the breath of {entity}—fierce as that violet fire may be, it is far less lethal than a single chill gust from the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: 去折断{entity}的羽翼吧，凡人。看看这头末地霸主在深渊的注视下能挣扎几时。
lines.en: Break the wings of {entity}, mortal. Let us see how long this lord of the End lasts beneath the Abyssal gaze.

lines.zh: 即便{entity}盘踞在黑曜石柱之间，它也逃不过群星归位时的终极寂灭。
lines.en: Though {entity} perches among obsidian pillars, it cannot escape the final silence when the stars are right.

lines.zh: 一头饥渴难耐的{entity}正在附近潜行，它那腐烂的喉咙里正发出贪婪的喘息。
lines.en: A starving {entity} stalks nearby, wet, greedy rasps rattling in its rotting throat.

lines.zh: {entity}曾是啃食腐肉与禁忌典籍的可悲生物，如今只剩下对鲜血的本能渴望。
lines.en: {entity} was once a wretched thing feeding on carrion and forbidden lore; now only brute thirst for blood remains.

lines.zh: 在深渊荒地与黑暗之地，像{entity}这样的食尸鬼多如牛毛，它们是疯狂最忠实的清道夫。
lines.en: Across the Abyssal Wasteland and Darklands, ghouls like {entity} swarm without number—madness's most faithful scavengers.

lines.zh: 那只{entity}正嗅着你的气味。莫要让这具傀儡的皮囊沦为它的盘中餐。
lines.en: That {entity} has caught your scent. Do not let this simulacrum's hide become its supper.

lines.zh: 那{entity}正是忠实侍奉于门扉之前的仆从——连它的每一次呼吸都在向扎哈尔致敬。
lines.en: That {entity} is a faithful servant before the Gate—every breath it draws pays homage to J'zahar.

lines.zh: 看看这只忠诚的{entity}吧。在无尽黑暗的意志面前，它比任何凡人都更懂得顺从。
lines.en: Look upon this loyal {entity}. Before the will of infinite darkness, it understands obedience better than any mortal.

lines.zh: 有{entity}随行在侧，凡俗的宵小之辈便不敢轻易造次。
lines.en: With {entity} at hand, petty earthly pests dare not step too boldly.

lines.zh: 这头{entity}认得你身上的气息。去吧，驱使它去撕碎那些阻碍道路的愚人。
lines.en: This {entity} knows the scent you wear. Go—turn it loose upon whatever fools bar your path.

lines.zh: 地上散落着{entity}，宛如某个早已陨落的旅人匆忙间遗弃的遗物。
lines.en: {entity} lies scattered upon the ground, like a relic dropped in haste by some fallen traveler.

lines.zh: 连这微不足道的{entity}也被遗弃在尘埃里——俯身拾起它，还是任由它被世界刷新抹去？
lines.en: Even this trivial {entity} lies abandoned in the dust—stoop to claim it, or leave it to vanish?

lines.zh: 凡人一生都在收集各种{entity}，到头来却没有一样能带进黑暗国度。
lines.en: Mortals spend their lives hoarding every sort of {entity}, yet cannot carry a single scrap into the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: 那枚静静躺在地上的{entity}，或许正是开启下一场仪式的微小拼图。
lines.en: That {entity} resting quietly on the earth may be the small piece needed for your next ritual.

lines.zh: 一枚{entity}正破空袭来！莫要像木桩一样傻站着，躲开或击碎它！
lines.en: A {entity} streaks through the air! Do not stand like a post—evade or shatter it!

lines.zh: 呼啸的{entity}划破空气，带着凡俗兵器特有的急躁与杀意。
lines.en: The whistling {entity} slices the air with the frantic malice of mortal arms.

lines.zh: 区区一枚{entity}，也妄图撼动深渊守门人的威严？
lines.en: Does a mere {entity} presume to rattle the majesty of the Gatekeeper of the Abyss?

lines.zh: 在{entity}命中这具傀儡之前，先一步决定你的身法吧。
lines.en: Move before that {entity} finds its mark upon this simulacrum.

lines.zh: 你正紧紧盯着那{looked}。记住，当你凝视某种存在时，深渊也在借你的双眼审视着它。
lines.en: You fix your gaze upon {looked}. Remember: when you stare at a creature, the Abyss appraises it through your eyes.

lines.zh: 你的视线锁定了{looked}。究竟是猎手在打量猎物，还是疯子在寻找同类？
lines.en: Your sight locks onto {looked}. Is it a hunter sizing up quarry, or a madman seeking kin?

lines.zh: 那{looked}似乎感受到了你目光中携带的异界寒意，正不安地躁动着。
lines.en: That {looked} seems to feel the alien chill in your stare and shifts uneasily.

lines.zh: 看清{looked}的轮廓了吧？在群星归位之时，这世间的一切形貌都将被彻底重塑。
lines.en: Do you see {looked} clearly? When the stars are right, every form in this world shall be remade.

lines.zh: 你注视着{looked}，而我注视着你——这层层叠叠的凝视之中，究竟谁才是真正的猎人？
lines.en: You watch {looked}, and I watch you—amid these layered gazes, who is the true hunter?

lines.zh: 看着{entity}吧。它正是深渊对这片尘世最直白的嘲弄。
lines.en: Behold {entity}. It is the Abyss's plainest mockery of this mortal dust.

lines.zh: Iä! 既然{entity}已现身于此，你便当知晓自己距离真正的深渊有多近。
lines.en: Iä! Since {entity} walks here, you ought to know how near you stand to the true Abyss.

lines.zh: 那{animal}似乎本能地察觉到了你身上属于奥穆索的寒意。
lines.en: That {animal} seems to sense by instinct the chill of Omothol clinging to you.

lines.zh: 温顺的{animal}在尘世间啃食草叶，却不知大地之下正沉睡着何等恐怖。
lines.en: Tame {animal} crops the grass in peace, unaware of what horrors slumber beneath the turf.

lines.zh: 哪怕是最坚硬的渊素与黑曜石，在{entity}的湮灭面前也会化作虚无。
lines.en: Even hardened Abyssalnite and obsidian dissolve to nothing before the annihilation of {entity}.

lines.zh: 凝视{entity}过久，连你的灵魂都仿佛要被那股倒错的法则抽空。
lines.en: Stare too long at {entity}, and it feels as though your very soul might be drained by its inverted laws.

lines.zh: 你听见周围的动静了么？世界仍在喧嚣，直到群星归位的那一刻。
lines.en: Do you hear the stirrings around you? The world still chatters—until the hour the stars are right.

lines.zh: Iä! {boss}的怒火已在眼前燃起——拔出你的利刃，或者化作尘埃！
lines.en: Iä! The wrath of {boss} blazes before you—draw your steel, or crumble to dust!

lines.zh: 在{entity}嘶哑的喉音里，我听见了深渊荒地那永恒的哀歌。
lines.en: In the rasping throat of {entity}, I hear the eternal dirge of the Abyssal Wasteland.

lines.zh: {entity}曾是某个不自量力的探索者，如今不过是深渊脚下的一具行尸。
lines.en: That {entity} was once some overreaching explorer; now it is merely a walking husk beneath the Abyss.

lines.zh: 这{count}个徘徊不去的影子，究竟是你的猎物，还是先一步踏入陷阱的饵料？
lines.en: Are these {count} lingering shadows your quarry, or bait set ahead of a trap?

lines.zh: 寥寥{count}道微弱的脉动在黑暗里起伏，很快便会归于沉寂。
lines.en: A mere {count} faint pulses rise and fall in the dark, soon to settle into silence.

lines.zh: 莫要被这{count}个喧闹的家伙迷乱了心神。记住，数量在真正的伟力面前毫无意义。
lines.en: Do not let these {count} noisy creatures rattle your wits. Remember: numbers mean nothing before true might.

lines.zh: 蚁群再多，也不过是大脚落下前的一片黑影罢了。
lines.en: However thick the swarm, it is still just a dark smudge before the boot descends.

lines.zh: 这{count}道孤独的影子站在不远处，似乎也在打量着你这具奇异的化身。
lines.en: This {count} lone shadow stands not far off, seemingly appraising your strange simulacrum in return.

lines.zh: 仅有{count}物在此，正好让你看清深渊的注视是如何在它身上投下阴影的。
lines.en: Only {count} creature—just enough to watch the Abyssal gaze cast its shadow over it.

lines.zh: 以自我毁灭来换取敌人的伤痛——这{entity}的疯狂倒有几分原始的悲壮。
lines.en: Trading its own ruin to wound a foe—there is a crude, frantic devotion in that {entity}.

lines.zh: {entity}的嘶鸣在耳边响起，如同定时引信发出的最后倒数。
lines.en: The hiss of {entity} rises at your ear like the final countdown of a burning fuse.

lines.zh: 来自火焰深渊的{entity}，与来自星海深渊的我们，本就不是同一条道路上的存在。
lines.en: {entity} of the fiery pit and we of the starless Abyss were never meant to walk the same path.

lines.zh: 若那{entity}敢于冒犯，便让它见识一下何为真正的深渊威压。
lines.en: Should that {entity} dare offend you, show it the weight of true Abyssal dread.

lines.zh: 巨兽的咆哮震动虚空，却撼动不了守门人半点心神。
lines.en: The roar of the great beast shakes the void, yet stirs not a hair on the Gatekeeper's brow.

lines.zh: 凡人踏入恐惧之地却未能保全自己，最终便会化作如{entity}这般的丑陋怪物。
lines.en: Mortals who enter the Dreadlands and fail to keep themselves whole end as wretched things like {entity}.

lines.zh: 用利刃与火焰净化眼前的{entity}吧，否则它只会继续散播绝望的瘟疫。
lines.en: Purge that {entity} before you with steel and flame, lest it spread its plague of despair further.

lines.zh: 空间在{entity}周身微微扭曲，恰如犹格·索托斯门扉开启前的一丝微澜。
lines.en: Space ripples faintly around {entity}, like a tiny tremor before the Gate of Yog-Sothoth swings wide.

lines.zh: 腐臭与恶寒随着{entity}的逼近而弥漫开来。赐予它一个痛快的终结吧。
lines.en: Stench and chill creep closer with {entity}. Grant it a swift end.

lines.zh: 看着{entity}那副枯槁的模样——那就是过度沉溺于肉体欲望与黑暗力量的下场。
lines.en: Look at the gaunt frame of {entity}—such is the end of gorging on dark power and base hunger.

lines.zh: 若连死物都能被赋予行动的指令，你又怎知自己不是某位外神指尖的一尊{entity}？
lines.en: If even dead matter can be given marching orders, how do you know you are not a {entity} at some Outer God's fingertips?

lines.zh: 冰冷的{entity}不会流血，也不会哀嚎，直到它被彻底砸成一堆废铁或碎石。
lines.en: Cold {entity} neither bleeds nor weeps, until it is smashed back into scrap and rubble.

lines.zh: 尘归尘，土归土。无人拾取的{entity}很快便会消散在虚空之中。
lines.en: Dust to dust. An unclaimed {entity} soon dissolves back into nothingness.

lines.zh: 你的目光落在了地上的{entity}。去吧，拿走这属于尘世的碎屑。
lines.en: Your eyes fall upon {entity} on the ground. Go on—gather up that earthly scrap.

lines.zh: 既已看准了{looked}，便决定它的命运吧：放过它，或是将它碾作尘埃。
lines.en: Now that you have {looked} in your sights, decide its fate: spare it, or grind it to dust.

lines.zh: 哪怕只是门扉守卫者最微末的{entity}，也携带着来自奥穆索的冰冷威严。
lines.en: Even the humblest {entity} of the Gatekeeper carries the cold majesty of Omothol.

lines.zh: Iä! {entity}已在此待命，只待一声令下便会扑向猎物。
lines.en: Iä! {entity} waits ready here, needing only a word to lunge at its prey.

lines.zh: {entity}的目光穿透了你的皮囊，仿佛在分辨你究竟是主人，还是一个偷穿圣袍的窃贼。
lines.en: The gaze of {entity} pierces your hide, weighing whether you are its master or a thief in stolen robes.

lines.zh: 奥穆索的住民从不轻易施舍怜悯——若无死灵之书在手，在{entity}眼中你便毫无价值。
lines.en: The denizens of Omothol never deal in pity; without a Necronomicon, you are worthless in {entity}'s eyes.

lines.zh: {entity}虽快，却快不过空间撕裂时的那一瞬闪光。
lines.en: Swift as {entity} flies, it is slower than the flash of space tearing apart.

lines.zh: 留神那道飞来的{entity}——哪怕是细小的箭矢，攒射之下也能洞穿铠甲。
lines.en: Mind that incoming {entity}—even a slender shaft pierces plate when loosed in earnest.

lines.zh: 在{entity}面前，寻常的刀剑往往显得笨拙而无力，唯有深渊的力量能与之抗衡。
lines.en: Against {entity}, common blades often feel clumsy and dull; only Abyssal power meets it on equal ground.

lines.zh: Iä! {entity}的眼睛在漆黑中闪烁，宛如黑暗领域向现世投来的冰冷一瞥。
lines.en: Iä! The eyes of {entity} glint in the pitch dark, like a cold glance cast from the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: Tekeli-li! {entity}的咆哮声撕扯着耳膜，连死灵之书的持有者也必须对它保持敬畏。
lines.en: Tekeli-li! The shriek of {entity} tears at the ears; even a bearer of the Necronomicon must treat it with wariness.

lines.zh: 敲碎这具{entity}的骨殖吧。死去已久的东西，理当安分地回到坟墓里去。
lines.en: Shatter the bones of this {entity}. What died long ago ought to stay quiet in its grave.

lines.zh: 那{entity}的骸骨看似脆弱，然则暗处射出的冷箭依然致命。
lines.en: The frame of {entity} looks brittle, yet a cold arrow loosed from the dark remains lethal.

lines.zh: 在奥穆索，连白骨都会在漫长的岁月里风化成灰——唯有这凡世的{entity}还在四处游荡。
lines.en: In Omothol even bone weathers to ash over the aeons—only this earthly {entity} still wanders abroad.

lines.zh: 听啊，{entity}肋骨碰撞的脆响，宛如丧钟在为你敲响拍子。
lines.en: Listen to the brittle clatter of {entity}'s ribs, keeping time like a funeral bell.

lines.zh: 连这团没有心智的胶质都知道追逐活人的体温，何其原始的本能。
lines.en: Even this mindless jelly knows enough to chase the warmth of living flesh—what crude instinct.

lines.zh: 踩碎这团卑微的软泥吧，莫让它污了这具化身的衣角。
lines.en: Crush this lowly ooze underfoot; do not let it foul the hem of this simulacrum.

lines.zh: 无论{entity}爬得有多快，也逃不出群星归位时那张笼罩天地的巨网。
lines.en: However swiftly {entity} scuttles, it cannot outrun the vast web that falls when the stars are right.

lines.zh: 当心别让{entity}绕到你的视野盲区。多足的猎手最擅长从阴影里偷袭。
lines.en: Watch that {entity} does not slip into your blind spot; many-legged hunters excel at ambush.

lines.zh: 让这具{entity}彻底归于死寂吧。在这个世界上，行走的尸体已经够多了。
lines.en: Return this {entity} to true stillness. There are already enough walking corpses in this world.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮囊下，{entity}早已忘却了生前曾有过的名字与祈祷。
lines.en: Beneath its rotting hide, {entity} has long forgotten the name and prayers it knew in life.

lines.zh: 对于{entity}而言，能在一个不知情的世界里老去，或许是莫大的幸运。
lines.en: For {entity}, growing old in an unsuspecting world may be the greatest fortune they could ask.

lines.zh: 这些{entity}甚至不敢念出黑暗之地的名字，更遑论直面奥穆索的守门人。
lines.en: These {entity} dare not even speak the name of the Darklands, let alone face the Gatekeeper of Omothol.

lines.zh: 让那个喧闹的{entity}闭嘴吧，她的药水味道令人作呕。
lines.en: Silence that noisy {entity}; the stench of her brews turns the stomach.

lines.zh: 区区凡俗的草药巫术，又岂能与黑暗国度真正的仪式相提并论？
lines.en: How could mere herbal sorcery compare to the true rituals of the Dark Realm?

lines.zh: 野性尚存的{entity}在荒野间自由奔跑，尚未被珊瑚或恐惧染指。
lines.en: Wild {entity} still runs free across the wastes, untouched as yet by Coralium or Dread.

lines.zh: 顺从的猎犬与狂暴的恶狼之间，往往只隔着一道饥饿的界限。
lines.en: Between a loyal hound and a rabid wolf lies only the thin line of hunger.

lines.zh: 一剑劈开这具{entity}的头颅吧，莫让这堆腐肉继续污染你的视线。
lines.en: Cleave the skull of this {entity} and be done; do not let rotting meat clutter your sight.

lines.zh: 腐朽的{entity}摇摇晃晃地走来，恰如凡人文明在末日降临前的最后蹒跚。
lines.en: The decayed {entity} lurches forward, like mortal civilization staggering toward its final hour.

lines.zh: 莫要被这具迟钝的{entity}围困——蚁多尚且能咬死象。
lines.en: Do not let sluggish {entity} box you in—even slow things kill when they swarm.

lines.zh: 它曾经也有过名字与过往，如今却只是一具连灵魂都已遗失的空壳。
lines.en: Once it had a name and a past; now it is only an empty husk that misplaced even its soul.
